info.name: LifeLink Complete QA - CRUD, Agents, Validation & Safety
info.description: Sequential QA collection for the hosted LifeLink API. Run the complete collection in order. It creates timestamped QA records and intentionally leaves audit records in PostgreSQL. Agent behavior is exercised through the backend workflow endpoints because the internal agent service is not publicly exposed.

request.description: Starts a unique data run. Execute this first.

exec: const campDay = new Date(Date.now()+48*3600*1000); campDay.setUTCHours(3, 30, 0, 0); // 09:00 Sri Lanka time; camps must run 06:00-21:00
pm.test('JWT token pair returned', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Profile defaults pending and active', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.eligibilityStatus).to.eql('PendingVerification'); pm.expect(j.isActive).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Healthy donor eligible after staff check', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('Eligible'));

exec: const items=pm.response.json().items; pm.test('Only own hospital data', () => pm.expect(items.every(x => x.hospitalId === pm.collectionVariables.get('hospitalId'))).to.eql(true)); const qa=items.find(x => x.notes === 'QA request for coordinator and dispatch analysis'); if(qa) pm.collectionVariables.set('requestId', qa.id);

item.name: Negative - donor cannot list hospital requests

exec: const x=pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.notes === 'QA cancellation path'); pm.test('Cancellable request persisted', () => pm.expect(x).to.exist); if(x) pm.collectionVariables.set('cancelRequestId', x.id);

const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Fully reserved', () => { pm.expect(j.fullyReserved).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.reservedUnits).to.eql(2); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('reservationId', j.reservations[0].id);

item.name: Negative - stock-in invalid units and expired date

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Slots generated', () => pm.expect(j).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotId', j[0].id);
pm.test('Booked donor is on roster', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.donorId === pm.collectionVariables.get('donorId'))).to.eql(true));

const list=pm.response.json(); const w=list.find(x => x.bloodRequestId === pm.collectionVariables.get('requestId')); pm.test('Workflow exists', () => pm.expect(w).to.exist); if(w) pm.collectionVariables.set('workflowId', w.id);

item.name: Validate all four agent steps and safety gate

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); const names=j.steps.map(s=>s.agentName); pm.test('All agents executed in order', () => pm.expect(names).to.eql(['CoordinatorAgent','DomainAnalysisAgent','DispatchAgent','ValidationSafetyAgent'])); pm.test('Workflow reached auditable outcome', () => pm.expect(['PendingApproval','EscalationRequired','Completed']).to.include(j.status)); pm.test('Each step persisted tool/audit JSON', () => j.steps.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.inputJson).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(s.toolCallsJson).to.be.a('string'); }));
